integrity: The infinite statement is proved from exact closed-neighborhood identities. Exhaustive finite enumeration is used only as an independent boundary and coefficient check, not as a proof of the general theorem.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes at least two clique blades. The literature search leaves a residual risk of an obscure equivalent treatment; the 2007 Dutch-windmill forcing paper was only partially inspectable directly, so the known homogeneous scalar case is explicitly excluded from the originality basis.
title: Signed-domination weight enumerator of heterogeneous windmill graphs
